subject: Chemistry
questionText: Phenol reacts with concentrated $\text{HNO}_3$ in the presence of concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ to give a major product $X$. What is the IUPAC name and SMILES chemical structure of product $X$?
solution: Concentrated nitrating mixture ($	ext{HNO}_3 + 	ext{H}_2	ext{SO}_4$) strongly nitrates phenol at both ortho and para positions due to the strong activating $+M$ effect of the $-	ext{OH}$ group, forming 2,4,6-Trinitrophenol (Picric acid).

subject: Chemistry
questionText: Consider the Reimer-Tiemann reaction of Phenol with chloroform ($	ext{CHCl}_3$) in aqueous $\text{NaOH}$ solution. Which of the following statements regarding the reaction mechanism is/are CORRECT?
options: The reactive electrophilic intermediate is Dichlorocarbene ($:\text{CCl}_2$).
The major product obtained after acidification is Salicylaldehyde (2-hydroxybenzaldehyde).
Intramolecular hydrogen bonding stabilizes the ortho-isomer over the para-isomer.
The reaction involves a free radical mechanism.
solution:
1. $\text{CHCl}_3 + \text{OH}^- \rightarrow :\text{CCl}_2 + \text{Cl}^- + \text{H}_2\text{O}$ (Dichlorocarbene electrophile, Option A is correct).
2. Major product is Salicylaldehyde (Option B is correct).
3. Chelation / Intramolecular H-bonding between $-\text{OH}$ and $-\text{CHO}$ stabilizes the ortho product (Option C is correct).

questionText: For the gaseous dissociation reaction $\text{N}_2\text{O}_4(g) \rightleftharpoons 2\text{NO}_2(g)$, the standard Gibbs free energy change at $T = 300\text{ K}$ is $\Delta G^\circ = 5.75\text{ kJ/mol}$. **Passage for Questions 4 and 5:**
An organic compound $A$ ($	ext{C}_7	ext{H}_6	ext{O}$) has a Benzene ring structure. Compound $A$ gives a positive 2,4-DNP test but negative Tollens and Fehling tests. On treatment with methylmagnesium bromide ($	ext{CH}_3	ext{MgBr}$) followed by acid hydrolysis, compound $A$ yields alcohol $B$.

subQuestions.solution: Acetophenone gives 2,4-DNP test (ketone) but does not reduce Tollens/Fehling reagents (ketones are non-reducing sugars/aldehydes).

subQuestions.questionText: Alcohol $B$ formed upon Grignard reaction is a:
subQuestions.solution: Grignard addition of $\text{CH}_3\text{MgBr}$ to Acetophenone gives 2-phenylpropan-2-ol, which is a tertiary ($3^\circ$) alcohol.

questionText: Match the coordination complexes in Column I with their geometric hybridization and magnetic properties in Column II:

column2: Q. $d^2 sp^3$ / Octahedral, Paramagnetic (1 unpaired electron)

solution:
A -> Q ($d^2sp^3$, low spin octahedral, $\text{Fe}^{3+} (d^5)$ 1 unpaired e-).
B -> R ($sp^3$, tetrahedral, $\text{Ni}^0 (d^{10})$ diamagnetic).
C -> S ($dsp^2$, square planar, $\text{Ni}^{2+} (d^8)$ strong field ligand $\text{CN}^-$ pairing).
D -> T ($sp^3$, tetrahedral, $\text{Mn}^{2+} (d^5)$ weak field $\text{Cl}^-$ high spin).
